text_en: While Peter and John were speaking to the people, the priests, the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees came to them,
text_cn: 正当他们向百姓讲话的时候，司祭、圣殿警官和撒杜塞人来到他们那里，

text_en: much annoyed because they were teaching the people and proclaiming that in Jesus there is the resurrection of the dead.
text_cn: 大为恼怒，因为他们教训百姓，并宣讲耶稣从死者中复活，

text_en: So they arrested them and put them in custody until the next day, for it was already evening.
text_cn: 遂下手拿住他们，押在拘留所里，直到第二天，因为天已晚了。

text_en: But many of those who heard the word believed; and they numbered about five thousand.
text_cn: 但听道的人中，有许多人信从了，男人的数目，大约有五千。

text_en: The next day their rulers, elders, and scribes assembled in Jerusalem,
text_cn: 到了第二天，犹太人的首领、长老和经师都聚集在耶路撒冷，

text_en: with Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, and Alexander, and all who were of the high-priestly family.
text_cn: 还有大司祭亚纳斯和盖法、若望、亚历山大以及大司祭家族的人。

text_en: When they had made the prisoners stand in their midst, they inquired, “By what power or by what name did you do this? ”
text_cn: 他们就令宗徒们站在中间，仔细考问说：“你们凭什么能力，或以谁的名义行这事？”

text_en: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “Rulers of the people and elders,
text_cn: 那时，伯多禄充满圣神，向他们说：“各位百姓首领和长老！

text_en: if we are questioned today because of a good deed done to someone who was sick and are asked how this man has been healed,
text_cn: 如果你们今天询问我们有关向一个病人行善的事，并且他怎样痊愈了，

text_en: let it be known to all of you, and to all the people of Israel, that this man is standing before you in good health by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead.
text_cn: 我很高兴告诉你们和全以色列百姓：是凭纳匝肋人耶稣基督的名字即是你们所钉死，天主从死者中所复活的；就是凭着这人，这个站在你们面前的人好了。

text_en: This Jesus is ‘the stone that was rejected by you, the builders; it has become the cornerstone. ’
text_cn: 这耶稣就是为你们‘匠人所弃而不用的石头，反而成了屋角基石。’

text_en: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given among mortals by which we must be saved. ”
text_cn: 除他以外，无论凭谁，决无救援，因为在天下人间，没有赐下别的名字，使我们赖以得救的。”

text_en: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John and realized that they were uneducated and ordinary men, they were amazed and recognized them as companions of Jesus.
text_cn: 他们看到伯多禄和若望的胆量，并晓得他们是没有读过书的平常人，就十分惊讶；他们既认出他们是同耶稣在一起的，

text_en: When they saw the man who had been cured standing beside them, they had nothing to say in opposition.
text_cn: 又看见那治好了的人，同他们一起站着，都无言可对。

text_en: So they ordered them to leave the council while they discussed the matter with one another.
text_cn: 遂命他们暂且离开公议会，彼此商议，

text_en: They said, “What will we do with them? For it is obvious to all who live in Jerusalem that a notable sign has been done through them; we cannot deny it.
text_cn: 说：“对这些人我们可以作什么呢？因为他们确实显了一个明显的奇迹，凡耶路撒冷的居民都知道了，我们也不能否认。

text_en: But to keep it from spreading further among the people, let us warn them to speak no more to anyone in this name. ”
text_cn: 但是，为叫这事不再在民间传播，我们当恐吓他们，叫他们不可再因这名字向任何人发言。”

text_en: So they called them and ordered them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.
text_cn: 遂叫了他们来，严令他们绝对不可再因耶稣的名发言施教。

text_en: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in God’s sight to listen to you rather than to God, you must judge;
text_cn: 伯多禄和若望却回答说：“听从你们而不听从天主，在天主前是否合理，你们评断罢！

text_en: for we cannot keep from speaking about what we have seen and heard. ”
text_cn: 因为我们不得不说我们所见所闻的事。”

text_en: After threatening them again, they let them go, finding no way to punish them because of the people, for all of them praised God for what had happened.
text_cn: 议员们为了百姓的原故，找不到借口来处罚他们，就把他们恐吓一番，予以释放了，因为众人都为所发生的事光荣天主。

text_en: For the man on whom this sign of healing had been performed was more than forty years old.
text_cn: 原来那因奇迹治好了的人，已有四十多岁了。

text_en: After they were released, they went to their friends and reported what the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
text_cn: 他们被释放之后，来到自己的人那里，报告了大司祭和长老向他们所说的一切；

text_en: When they heard it, they raised their voices together to God and said, “Sovereign Lord, who made the heaven and the earth, the sea, and everything in them,
text_cn: 大家一听，都同心合意地高声向天主说：“上主！‘是你创造了天地海洋，和其中的一切。’

text_en: it is you who said by the Holy Spirit through our ancestor David, your servant: ‘Why did the Gentiles rage, and the peoples imagine vain things?
text_cn: 你曾以圣神藉我们的祖先，你的仆人达味的口说过：‘异民为何叛乱？万民为何策划妄事？

text_en: The kings of the earth took their stand, and the rulers have gathered together against the Lord and against his Messiah. ’
text_cn: 世上的君王起来，首领聚集在一起，反对上主和他的受傅者。’

text_en: For in this city, in fact, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the peoples of Israel, gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,
text_cn: 实在，黑落德和般雀比拉多与异民和以色列人聚集在这座城内，反对你的圣仆人耶稣，反对你的受傅者，

text_en: to do whatever your hand and your plan had predestined to take place.
text_cn: 实行了你的手和计划所预定要成就的事。

text_en: And now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
text_cn: 现今，上主！请注意他们的恐吓，赐你的仆人以绝大的胆量，宣讲你的真道，

text_en: while you stretch out your hand to heal, and signs and wonders are performed through the name of your holy servant Jesus. ”
text_cn: 同时伸出你的手，藉你的圣仆人耶稣的名字治病，显征兆，行奇迹。”

text_en: When they had prayed, the place in which they were gathered together was shaken; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God with boldness.
text_cn: 他们祈祷后，他们聚集的地方震动起来，众人都充满了圣神，大胆地宣讲天主的真道。

text_en: Now the whole group of those who believed were of one heart and soul, and no one claimed private ownership of any possessions, but everything they owned was held in common.
text_cn: 众信徒都是一心一意，凡各人所有的，没有人说是自己的，都归公用。

text_en: With great power the apostles gave their testimony to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and great grace was upon them all.
text_cn: 宗徒们以大德能，作证主耶稣的复活，在众人前大受爱戴。

text_en: There was not a needy person among them, for as many as owned lands or houses sold them and brought the proceeds of what was sold.
text_cn: 在他们中，没有一个贫乏的人，因为凡有田地和房屋的，卖了以后，把卖得的价钱带来，

text_en: They laid it at the apostles’ feet, and it was distributed to each as any had need.
text_cn: 放在宗徒们脚前，照每人所需要的分配。

text_en: There was a Levite, a native of Cyprus, Joseph, to whom the apostles gave the name Barnabas (which means “son of encouragement”).
text_cn: 有位若瑟，宗徒称之为巴尔纳伯，解说“安慰之子”，是肋未人，生于塞浦路斯岛，

text_en: He sold a field that belonged to him, then brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
text_cn: 他有田地，卖了以后，也把银钱带来，放在宗徒脚前。
